title: Probability as the integral of an indicator
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a finite probability space and let $S \subseteq \Omega$ be any subset. Then the probability of $S$ equals the integral of the indicator function of $S$ against the probability measure:
\[
  \mathbb{P}(S) \;=\; \int_\Omega \bigl(\text{if } \omega \in S \text{ then } 1 \text{ else } 0\bigr)\,d\omega,
\]
where the left-hand side is the real number obtained from the measure of $S$.
hypotheses_covered: Ω is a finite probability space
S is a subset of Ω
